description.en: The source of the namespace. Required only for specific third-party cases.

description.zh: 原始应用ID，任务原本所在的应用分组。
description.en: The source application group to which the task belongs.

description.zh: 原始命名空间，任务原本所在的命名空间。
description.en: The source namespace where the task resides.

description.zh: 目标应用ID，任务需要同步到的应用分组。
description.en: The ID of the destination application group to which the task will be synchronized.

description.en: The destination namespace to which the task will be synchronized.
